reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text: Chordify is in your face to pay for its services. It is hard to press anything without multiple pop-ups consistently. The layout is bad and clunky

reviews.title: Useful but very unethical with privacy
reviews.text: They make it very hard to opt out of tracking a lot of details about you and even if you say no and you spend 10 minutes going through all the options to take off there in their warning they still say that they might use them anyway if they determine it’s a legitimate interest. Them and their vendor partners not even only them.

reviews.title: Update needed - sort order
reviews.text: It’s stopped working completely!!! Please can you allow me to sort my songs by oldest first?

reviews.title: Premium
reviews.text:
I paid for annual premium but get nothing but ads and constant requests to go premium! 
Not worth the hassle.

reviews.title: For beginners. No free trial.
reviews.text:
Ok for beginners.
If you are more advanced there are better app options.
No free trial. Hence one star.
I signed up for the premium subscription.
I used the app for just 5mins before releasing this wasn’t for me. Too late, I’m £30 worse off. A very expensive 5mins.

reviews.title: No music
reviews.text: Can no longer play most YouTube songs so not possible to play along which is the whole point of this app.

reviews.title: Easily the most frustrating app.
reviews.text: Insane number of invasive adverts. You can’t get anywhere. Constant pop ups. Deleted.

reviews.title: Videos not working again
reviews.text: Was great again when they sorted out the you tube problem but Once again you can no longer play along with original video
